Answers

How you will be using the constructor in selenium

Constructors are fundamental to the Page Object Model (POM). “In my Selenium framework, I use constructors in every Page Object class. The primary purpose is dependency injection—specifically, to pass the WebDriver instance from the test class to the page object. This ensures that the page object has the necessary driver to find elements and perform actions.
